text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Rickey-chan. And with that 
said, here's yer birthday gift.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I made a special case just for your Feng 
Shui compass, Rickey-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, thank you~!\nEverything you make is 
so cute and comforting, Acute-san, I just 
love it!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm glad, so glad. I hope ye like 
the design too. I stitched a Taiji symbol 
on it~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
This time, I'm incorporating a rather 
unusual method. The name was, uh...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"...Now what was it called again? 
'Hip-hope', was it?"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hip-hop...? Was there ever a sewing stitch 
called that?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it's something made by sewing pieces 
of cloth together, but... let's see...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, patchwork!? You sewed a Taiji diagram 
out of patchwork!?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right, "patchwork"! As expected 
of Rickey-chan.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Same to you! You're as amazing as ever, 
Acute-san! Just too incredible~!
